thermal_energy_conservation.requirement: eps_max < 1e-12 over every shared LBM<->FEM run

thermal_profile_accuracy.requirement: rel-L2 temperature error < 3 % vs exact 1-D slab (r = 1)
thermal_profile_accuracy.baseline: exact series solution of T_t = alpha T_yy, Dirichlet/adiabatic

thermal_falsification_ratio.requirement: independent-flux control residual > 1e3 x shared residual

mechanical_contact_engaged.requirement: max contact overlap > 0 in every shared mechanical run
mechanical_contact_engaged.note: contact occurred in every shared run
mechanical_contact_engaged.baseline: impact scenario, max overlap ~1.2e-4 m over the full run

mechanical_energy_convergence.requirement: energy drift monotone decreasing in r and < 5 % at r = 8
mechanical_energy_convergence.note: first-order integrator drift, decreasing with r
mechanical_energy_convergence.baseline: drift halves per doubling of r (measured 0.155 -> 0.017)

mechanical_falsification_ratio.requirement: lagged-reaction control momentum residual > 1e2 x shared

three_field_energy_chain.requirement: eps_max < 1e-3 over every shared LBM<->FEM<->DEM run
three_field_energy_chain.baseline: total stored energy minus external input, snapshot form

three_field_thermal_subchain.requirement: thermal sub-chain residual < 1e-12 inside the chain
three_field_thermal_subchain.baseline: round-off of the thermal ledger alone

three_field_physics_engaged.requirement: every shared chain run has external heat input > 0 and contact energy > 0
three_field_physics_engaged.baseline: hot lower face + ice impact, Q_in > 0 and E_contact > 0

plate_first_frequency.requirement: FEM clamped-free axial frequency within 3 % of c/(4L)
plate_first_frequency.baseline: Euler-Bernoulli axial mode, f = c/(4L) = 1863.39 Hz

matrix_completeness.requirement: 48 runs = 4 ratios x 3 schemes x 3 couplings + 4 x 3 controls

falsification_arm_coverage.requirement: each of the three couplings contributes >= 1 independent run
falsification_arm_coverage.note: each coupling has its control arm
falsification_arm_coverage.baseline: one control per coupling and ratio
